_readme: R335 A-Conform pre-seeded exceptions — the DOCUMENTED Arabic adaptations. The runner counts every assertion resolved through one of these rules; they must cover <5% of all assertions (reported as exceptionUsage). pathPattern is a regex matched against the Heron role path (empty pattern = applies to every element).

exceptions.rule: Heron tracking (negative or positive) is treated as '0 required'; our computed letter-spacing must satisfy |ls| ≤ 0.05em (Arabic script joins letters — positive tracking breaks the joins, Heron's negative Latin tracking is meaningless in Arabic).

When Heron's line-height is < 1.35 × its font-size and ours is ≥ 1.35 × ours, the assertion passes via exception (Arabic ascenders/descenders need the taller metric box; exact px equality is not required).
x-geometry is compared MIRRORED: distance-from-viewport-center of Heron vs ours (our page is RTL, Heron LTR — the axis is flipped by design). Counts as exception use so the mirror rate stays visible.
exceptions.reason: RTL layout mirrors Heron's LTR x-axis

exceptions.rule: Text-length class may differ by ±1 class (none↔short↔medium↔long) where the Arabic copy is more compact than the English source.
exceptions.reason: Arabic copy is more compact than English
